strands.name: Strand A: Scientific Investigation Skills and Career Exploration

overalls.title: Scientific Investigation Skills
overalls.description: demonstrate scientific investigation skills (related to both inquiry and research) in the four areas of skills (initiating and planning, performing and recording, analysing and interpreting, and communicating)

specifics.description: I can ask scientific questions, make predictions, and plan safe investigations.
I can conduct experiments, collect accurate data, and organize it effectively.
I can analyse and interpret data, identify sources of error, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
I can communicate my findings using scientific language, appropriate formats, and precise measurements.

overalls.title: Career Exploration
overalls.description: identify and describe a variety of careers related to the fields of science under study, and identify scientists, including Canadians, who have made contributions to those fields

specifics.description: I can identify science-related careers and describe Canadian scientific contributions.

strands.name: Strand B: Biology — Tissues, Organs, and Systems of Living Things

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate the importance of medical technologies in the diagnosis and treatment of disease, and assess social and ethical issues related to technological developments

specifics.description: I can evaluate the societal impact and ethical implications of medical technologies.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate cell division and cell specialization in animals and plants

specifics.description: I can examine cell division (mitosis), specialized cells, and animal/plant organ systems through microscope work and labs.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the hierarchical organization of cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems

specifics.description: I can explain the hierarchy of biological organization from cells to organ systems in plants and animals.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse how chemical reactions are used in various applications, and assess their environmental and societal impacts

specifics.description: I can evaluate the impacts of household and industrial chemical reactions on health and the environment.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate different types of chemical reactions and acid-base solutions

specifics.description: I can write word and balanced chemical equations and investigate synthesis, decomposition, displacement, and neutralization reactions.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of chemical reactions and the law of conservation of mass

specifics.description: I can explain ionic and covalent bonding, chemical nomenclature, and pH scales.

strands.name: Strand D: Earth and Space Science — Earth's Climate System

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse effects of climate change on natural systems and human communities, and evaluate initiatives to counter climate change

specifics.description: I can analyze regional and global impacts of climate change and evaluate mitigation strategies.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate indicators and factors that influence Earth's climate system

specifics.description: I can analyze climate indicators, ice core data, and greenhouse gas trends.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of climate systems, heat transfer, and the greenhouse effect

specifics.description: I can explain heat transfer in the atmosphere and oceans, albedo, and natural/anthropogenic greenhouse effects.

strands.name: Strand E: Physics — Light and Geometric Optics

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate social and environmental impacts of optical technologies and describe developments in optical applications

specifics.description: I can evaluate applications of optical devices (cameras, microscopes, telescopes, fiber optics).

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate properties of light, reflection, and refraction through mirrors and lenses

specifics.description: I can draw ray diagrams and solve optics equations for plane/curved mirrors and converging/diverging lenses.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the wave and particle nature of light, reflection, and refraction

specifics.description: I can explain Snell's Law, total internal reflection, index of refraction, and image characteristics.
